observations.title: Aim through non-colliding plants
observations.player_action: Swing at a target behind tall grass or another block without a collision shape.
observations.outcome: Upstream changes targeting so plant removal is not required just to land the attack.
conditions: Cross-mod hit targeting, reach and Epic Fight collision behavior remain distinct installed-version questions.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Use the actual damage/attack owner to detect a successful hit. Cursor targeting through foliage alone is not damage proof, especially with Epic Fight.
